claims.claim: For A with shape (m,p) and B with shape (p,n), matrix multiplication produces C with shape (m,n).
claims.notes: Broadcasting batch dimensions is distinct from the contracted matrix dimension.

claims.claim: The SVD factors a matrix into left singular vectors, singular values, and right singular vectors, with shapes determined by full_matrices.
claims.notes: The tutorial distinguishes reduced and full SVD; singular vectors are not unique under sign flips.

claims.claim: PCA centers features before finding principal directions and orders components by explained variance.
claims.notes: Whitening changes component scales; PCA does not automatically standardize feature units.

claims.claim: Truncating the SVD to the leading singular components yields a rank-k approximation under the Frobenius and spectral norm criteria.
claims.notes: This is a mathematical property, not a guarantee that the compressed features preserve task-relevant information.
